import json, sys, time, subprocess, urllib.request
import websocket

def cdp_dialog_test(url, name):
    proc = subprocess.Popen([
        "/usr/bin/chromium", "--headless=new", "--no-sandbox",
        "--disable-dev-shm-usage", "--remote-debugging-port=9333",
        "--user-data-dir=/tmp/cdp_profile", "about:blank"
    ], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    try:
        # wait for devtools endpoint
        ws_url = None
        for _ in range(50):
            time.sleep(0.3)
            try:
                data = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:9333/json"))
                pages = [t for t in data if t.get("type") == "page"]
                if pages:
                    ws_url = pages[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"]
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass
        if not ws_url:
            print(f"{name}: FAILED to connect CDP")
            return
        ws = websocket.create_connection(ws_url, timeout=10)
        mid = [0]
        def send(method, params=None):
            mid[0] += 1
            ws.send(json.dumps({"id": mid[0], "method": method, "params": params or {}}))
            return mid[0]
        send("Page.enable")
        send("Page.navigate", {"url": url})
        dialog = None
        end = time.time() + 8
        while time.time() < end:
            try:
                ws.settimeout(1.0)
                msg = json.loads(ws.recv())
            except Exception:
                continue
            if msg.get("method") == "Page.javascriptDialogOpening":
                dialog = msg["params"]
                break
        print(f"{name}: dialog event = {dialog}")
        ws.close()
    finally:
        proc.terminate()
        try:
            proc.wait(timeout=5)
        except Exception:
            proc.kill()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    cdp_dialog_test(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
PYEOF
